environment.execution: local Node.js Worker handler with node:sqlite DatabaseSync in-memory D1 double

method.warmup: One complete detailed /field read before measurement
method.timing: median wall time around local harness API call, including JSON response decoding
method.response_size: UTF-8 bytes of JSON.stringify(decoded response), uncompressed
method.sql_count: Statements executed by first/all/run plus each statement in a D1 batch for the measured request
method.comparison: Current detailed projection compared with current ownership-only projection; not an end-to-end old-release versus new-release benchmark

interpretation: The ownership refresh transfers substantially less data and avoids unnecessary campaign evaluation/defense work. Local timing does not establish production concurrency capacity, latency, device frame rate, or full-game speedup.
